headline: RugCheck AI screens Solana tokens for rug pulls & honeypots, protecting AI trading agents
summary: This new MCP server vets SPL / Token-2022 tokens for common scam patterns like active mint or freeze authorities, executing MEV-protected swaps for autonomous trading agents.
details: RugCheck AI is a new MCP server designed to enhance the safety of autonomous trading agents on Solana. It addresses the critical issue of agents trading blindly, often falling victim to rug pulls, honeypots, or tokens with malicious authorities.

The tool screens any SPL / Token-2022 token for common scam patterns directly on-chain. This allows agents to vet a token's legitimacy before making a purchase, a capability often missing in current autonomous trading setups.

After screening, RugCheck AI executes the swap through an MEV-protected route, integrating both the safety check and the transaction execution into a single process. This streamlines the trading workflow while minimizing risks.

A key focus is detecting 'authority' traps: a live mint authority can allow a deployer to print unlimited supply post-purchase, while a freeze authority can lock tokens, preventing holders from selling. RugCheck AI reads these on-chain fields to provide an immediate verdict.

RugCheck AI is listed on the official MCP Registry (io.github.MrWizardlyLoaf/rugcheck-ai) and can be used via a remote endpoint without installation. It is also open-source under the MIT license, with its code available on GitHub for self-hosting.
caption:

headline: Renault pioneers electric motors with no rare earths, a unique strategic position.
summary: Renault Group is unique in the automotive market as a pioneer of electric motors that do not use rare earths. This position has been reasserted for strategic reasons.
details: Renault Group stands out in the automotive industry as a pioneer in developing electric motors that operate without the need for rare earth materials. This technological approach sets the company apart from many competitors.

The company has officially reasserted this unique position, emphasizing its strategic importance within the automotive market. This move underscores Renault's distinct approach to electric vehicle technology.
